SUMMARY: Add a new method PlanWithFilter to the Planner interface in bucket_compactor.go, which filters blocks before planning. Implement it in SplitAndMergePlanner by extracting validation logic, and update the mock in compactor_test.go to satisfy the interface. Add unit tests in split_merge_planner_test.go to verify filtering behavior.

FILES:
- mimir/pkg/compactor/bucket_compactor.go — Defines the Planner interface; add PlanWithFilter method signature
- mimir/pkg/compactor/split_merge_planner.go — Only concrete Planner implementation; add PlanWithFilter method
- mimir/pkg/compactor/split_merge_planner_test.go — Add unit tests for PlanWithFilter
- mimir/pkg/compactor/compactor_test.go — Update tsdbPlannerMock to implement PlanWithFilter
